items.headline: Thunder Hit Hard by Injuries: Williams, Wallace Out for Season, Holmgren to Miss Months
items.summary: The OKC Thunder have suffered a devastating blow with Jalen Williams sustaining a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, and Cason Wallace tearing his left labrum, effectively ending both their seasons. In more tough news for OKC, Chet Holmgren underwent a 'biological treatment' for a small patellar tendon tear and is expected to miss 8-10 weeks, potentially returning around early 2027.

items.headline: Anthony Edwards Undergoes Knee Surgery, Sidelined for Up to Two Months
items.summary: Minnesota Timberwolves star Anthony Edwards, who was playing at an MVP level averaging 33.3 points, 4.8 rebounds, and 3.5 assists, underwent arthroscopic surgery on his right knee. The procedure could sideline him for up to two months, with a potential return around Christmas or early 2027.

items.headline: Kawhi Leonard Out with Knee Swelling
items.summary: Clippers forward Kawhi Leonard will miss Monday's game against the Raptors due to swelling in his left knee and is slated for re-evaluation later this week. The team announced he will undergo a treatment and rehabilitation program, but medical imaging revealed no acute injury.

items.headline: Celtics Extend Win Streak to Five
items.summary: Jayson Tatum's 32 points led the Celtics to their fifth consecutive victory, overpowering the Magic on the road.

items.headline: Nets Secure First Win Against Pacers
items.summary: Michael Porter Jr. dropped 23 points and Julius Randle added 20 to help the Nets secure their first win of the season over the Pacers.

items.headline: Lendeborg's Career Night Powers Warriors Past Clippers
items.summary: Yaxel Lendeborg exploded for 37 points in a career-best performance, guiding the Warriors to a decisive win over the Clippers.

items.headline: Doncic's 45-Point Masterclass Lifts Lakers Over Raptors
items.summary: Luka Doncic delivered a spectacular 45-point, 15-rebound, 6-assist, and 5-steal performance to lead the Lakers to a victory against the Raptors.

items.headline: Luka Doncic's Monster Night
items.summary: Luka Doncic lit up the stat sheet with 45 points, 15 rebounds, 6 assists, and 5 steals in the Lakers' win over the Raptors.

items.headline: Yaxel Lendeborg's Career High
items.summary: Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg stepped up big for the Warriors, recording a career-high 37 points along with 4 rebounds and 6 assists against the Clippers.

items.headline: Tatum Leads Celtics
items.summary: Jayson Tatum continued his strong start to the season with 32 points, 4 rebounds, and 7 assists in Boston's win over Orlando.

items.headline: Kessler's Double-Double
items.summary: Walker Kessler was a force on the boards for the Lakers, notching 16 points, 15 rebounds, and 3 blocks against the Raptors.

items.headline: Thunder at Cavaliers Tonight on National TV
items.summary: Despite significant injury woes, the OKC Thunder are scheduled to face the Cleveland Cavaliers tonight at 7:00 PM ET on Peacock and NBC Sports Network in one of the 15 games on the NBA slate.

items.headline: Celtics and Rockets in Early Season Showdown
items.summary: Two of the league's top teams, the 5-1 Celtics and the 6-1 Rockets, face off tonight at 8:30 PM ET in Houston. Alperen Şengün (22.8 PPG, 9 RPG, 7.4 APG) will lead the Rockets against Jayson Tatum (28.3 PPG, 6 RPG, 7.7 APG) and the streaking Celtics.

items.headline: Warriors Host Suns in Western Conference Clash
items.summary: The 4-3 Golden State Warriors, fresh off a win without their stars, will host the 1-3 Phoenix Suns tonight at 10:00 PM ET. The Warriors look to continue their momentum with Stephen Curry and Draymond Green expected back, while Devin Booker (22.3 PPG) aims to get the Suns back on track.

items.headline: Grizzlies, Trail Blazers, and Mavericks Rising in Power Rankings
items.summary: Early season shifts in power rankings see the undefeated Memphis Grizzlies, along with the Trail Blazers and Mavericks, making significant climbs. Meanwhile, several injury-plagued teams are falling back.

items.headline: Wemby Leads Spurs Against Jazz Seeking Win
items.summary: The 4-2 San Antonio Spurs, riding a four-game win streak, host the 1-5 Utah Jazz at 8:30 PM ET. Victor Wembanyama leads the Spurs with 28 PPG, 10.67 RPG, and 4.17 BPG, while Keyonte George (21.7 PPG, 6.3 APG) will try to spark Utah.
